messages:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: changewindow starting for service=completion-api, rollout v6.0.0. Preflight checks running. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/rollouts/5167001234 :rocket:
arun: Heads-up everyone — v6 bundles a new attention-cache optimizer. We saw small p99 regressions on long-context runs in perf tests; p50/p95 were fine.
tia: Seeing a small uptick in 429s from client-side throttles during shadowing (0.3% -> 0.9%). Might be client backlog not server-side. ops-bot: autoscale events: scale_up triggered in us-east-1 (reason: queue_depth).
perf-bot: quick summary:
````
- p50: baseline 45ms -> 48ms (+6%)
- p95: baseline 190ms -> 198ms (+4%)
- p99: baseline 420ms -> 510ms (+21%)
- error_rate: 0.05% -> 0.08%
````
alana: Given p99 bump, recommend pause at 5% and increase shadow sampling to 2k, also enable fallback route to v5.9.8 for retries. We'll need to update release notes & incident doc if we hold. Link: https://docs.redwood/releases/5167
arun: Agree. Proposal: pause traffic shift, pin retries to v5.9.8 for 1h, enable perf-tracing on affected pods, and run targeted long-context load tests. If p99 drops <10% delta over 10m, resume.
deploy-bot: Applying actions: pause_shift -> ok, route.pin(retries)=v5.9.8 -> ok, tracing=on -> ok. Shadow sampling set to 2000. Action log: https://deploys.redwood/logs/5167001234
tia: Notifying CS for customers on high-context ingest (CS ticket# CS-998).
ops-bot: Created tracking incident: INC-5167001234 (monitoring dashboard pinned). Oncall notified: @oncall
perf-bot: kicked off targeted long-context job: job-id long-5167. Will post results.
arun: Also worth noting KV cache hit dropped to 64% on initial shadow sample vs baseline 88% — might be cache warmup issue with new optimizer.
alana: Good catch — if cache drop persists we may fallback to previous kernel. Set rollback threshold: error_rate>0.5% OR p99>+30% sustained 3m.
tia: I'll update the changelog with hold and fallback steps: https://docs.redwood/releases/5167#changelog
perf-bot: long-5167 results (quick):
````
- samples: 1500
- p99: 475ms (delta +13%)
- kv_hit: 78%
- errors: 3/1500 (0.2%)
````
arun: Slightly better on long run, kv cache recovering. p99 still above threshold for auto-go, but within our manual tolerance. Recommend wait 8m and re-evaluate.
deploy-bot: automated-check scheduled in 8m. Next manual thumbs in 10m.
alana: I'll prepare rollback playbook in case we need to revert quickly (steps + contact links).
tia: CS notified, users on the list have been told we'll monitor and keep them updated.
arun: thumbs to continue hold and gather signal?
alana: :thumbsup: hold
perf-bot: :thumbsup: hold
deploy-bot: Hold active. If any metric trips rollback thresholds, I'll auto-initiate rollback and post here.
ops-bot: Observability note: add trace_id header to noise filter to isolate client retries. Patch pushed to observability pipeline.
perf-bot: automated recheck (8m): p99 202ms -> 210ms on short contexts, long p99 462ms, kv_hit 82%, error_rate 0.12%. No rollback.
arun: OK to step to 10% traffic if no new anomalies in next 5m. Set resume window 5m.
tia: I'll stand by on CS comms and update release notes with step changes.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Reschedule resume check in 5m.
